Messages.Author: Marc Erl
Messages.Body:
Greetings to all of thee!
I've got a simple question: Imagine I have used a Deflection to throw a
bleed that was directed at me against my prey. Is my prey then allowed
to use another Deflection, Telepathic counter or other Reaction Cards?
Well, at first one would say "yes of course", but the Text states: "...
The Methuselah you chose can attempt to block....". It says not that he
can play reaction cards... so?????

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Marc Erl <er...@uni-muenster.de> wrote:
>I've got a simple question: Imagine I have used a Deflection to throw a
>bleed that was directed at me against my prey. Is my prey then allowed
>to use another Deflection, Telepathic counter or other Reaction Cards?
>Well, at first one would say "yes of course", but the Text states: "...
>The Methuselah you chose can attempt to block....". It says not that he
>can play reaction cards... so?????

Deflection is played during the standard modifier/reaction sequence,
so reactions are still legal once the bleed is bounced, as are action
modifiers.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
